name: WS-E Cottonwood Model-Portfolio Fold-In (production) -- supersedes MDPF_COTMDL
description: Fold Cottonwood's model portfolios into the MDPF page on the opal-data-assets estate pattern (Andrew-direct 2026-07-21). Models live in the BD Rebalancer (60 models, 17 strict-Opal in scope, 296 accounts across 14 assigned Opal models); join account->model by strategyName; count-vs-dollar mechanism = +1 count per underlying primary model, dollars split by blend children[].relativeAllocation. Taxonomy: blackdiamond/cottonwood/{bronze|silver|gold|meta}, mirror the opal-assets-bd49f producer. Supersedes MDPF_COTMDL (whose on-hold premise -- silver strategy field unpopulated -- was a false negative). Grounded on the WS-E discovery deliverable. PRD docs/architecture/WSE_COTTONWOOD_MDPF_FOLDIN_PRD.md.
